description: Meet 전사에서 사용자가 수요일까지 약속 → 다음 날 요청자의 메일 "Friday is fine for the implementation plan" → 새 할 일 없이 기한만 금요일로(규칙 0 · 4). 회의에서 동료 · 상대가 한 약속은 뽑지 않는다.

sources.text:
[Google Meet · Implementation kickoff — Corbel]
Nina Alvarez: Thanks for joining, everyone. The main thing we need from your side is the implementation plan.
Alex Kim: Sure. I'll send the implementation plan by Wednesday.
Nina Alvarez: Perfect. We'll share the SSO settings with your team tomorrow.
Noah Patel: And I'll set up the staging environment this week.

제목: Implementation plan timing

Hi Alex,

Our steering meeting moved to next Tuesday, so Friday is fine for the implementation plan.

Best,
Nina
